name: V.I.O.L.E.T.
description:
Per Piece: +0.5 Block Interaction Range

Set Bonus (3+ Pieces):
- You can sneak right click with a set piece on any block with an inventory to Tether to it. 
- Activating your chestplate opens the tethered inventory.
- Activating the helmet cycles your inventory contents 1 row up.
- Activating the boots cycles them 1 row down.
